vocabulary.example: Plastic waste is a big problem.

vocabulary.example_ko: 우리는 플라스틱 사용을 줄일 수 있어요.

vocabulary.example: We should take care of the planet.

grammar.explanation_en: Use passive voice (be + past participle) when the action is more important than who did it: 'Plastic is thrown away every day' (we don't say who throws it). Form: subject + am/is/are + past participle: 'Trees are cut down', 'Energy is wasted.'
grammar.explanation_ko: 누가 했는지보다 행동 자체가 중요할 때 수동태(be + 과거분사)를 씁니다: 'Plastic is thrown away every day'(누가 버리는지는 말하지 않음). 형태: 주어 + am/is/are + 과거분사: 'Trees are cut down'(나무가 베인다), 'Energy is wasted'(에너지가 낭비된다).

examples.en: A lot of plastic is thrown away every year.
Forests are cut down for farmland.
Solar energy is used in many countries.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Did you know a lot of plastic is thrown into the ocean every year?
dialogue.line_ko: 매년 많은 플라스틱이 바다에 버려진다는 거 알았어요?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, it's a serious problem. We should recycle more.
dialogue.line_ko: 네, 심각한 문제예요. 우리는 재활용을 더 해야 해요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: I try to reduce plastic use at home.
dialogue.line_ko: 저는 집에서 플라스틱 사용을 줄이려고 노력해요.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: That's great! Every small action helps protect the planet.
dialogue.line_ko: 멋지네요! 작은 행동 하나하나가 지구를 보호하는 데 도움이 돼요.

reading.title: Protecting Our Planet
reading.text: Every year, millions of tons of plastic are thrown away. Many forests are cut down, and this damages the environment. However, more renewable energy is being used now than before. If we reduce waste and recycle, we can protect the planet for future generations.
reading.text_ko: 매년 수백만 톤의 플라스틱이 버려져요. 많은 숲이 베어지고, 이는 환경을 손상시켜요. 하지만 이전보다 지금 더 많은 재생 에너지가 사용되고 있어요. 우리가 쓰레기를 줄이고 재활용한다면, 미래 세대를 위해 지구를 보호할 수 있어요.

explanation.en: The text says 'millions of tons of plastic are thrown away.'
The text says 'this damages the environment.'

questions.prompt: 지금 더 많이 사용되고 있는 것은?

explanation.en: The text says 'more renewable energy is being used now.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'more renewable energy is being used'라고 나옵니다.
